scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a housing loan and I wanted to check the status of my application. Can you tell me if it has been approved or denied?
That's great to hear! Can you tell me what my interest rate is and the total costs of the loan?
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 5.750% and the total costs of the loan are $18,553.79.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. Can you also tell me if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan? And has my loan been sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage and it does not have any negative amortization features. The record does not indicate that your loan has been sold to another institution.

dialogue.user: Great, thank you for clarifying that. One last thing, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: You were approved for an FHA:First Lien loan product.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for the information. I appreciate your help.

<Very Satisfied> The agent was very helpful and provided all the information I needed in a clear and professional manner.
